name: mandarake-auction-scraper
title: Mandarake Auction Scraper — まんだらけ オークション
description: Scrape Japanese auction listings from Mandarake (まんだらけ), Japan's premier anime/manga/figures/toys/collectibles auction platform. Supports 60+ categories, keyword search with pagination, RSS feed, and item detail pages. Extract item name, current/start price (JPY), bid count, watchers, shop, images, description, end date. Python/httpx/BeautifulSoup.
